Can I get a brief explanation on how covenant binding works?
How to do it efficiently and such. How is it different from equipping covenants regularly, do team unique effects still apply, etc
only difference is that it gives bonus main stat
and also, those cov pieces you used to bind cannot be used by other awakeners
the character that has a bound cov can still use other covenants tho

covenant binding gives you a +50% boost to the main stat but you can't use that piece on other awakeners anymore
you can still freely overwrite it with a non-bound covenant on the awakener with a bound covenant

a lot of characters will only have one main stat they really care about so you can half bind a set and leave the rest unbound if you like

team unique effects apply as normal

you can unbind them for a cost of 10 covenant pieces from the same set
and they're quite a hassle to remove, requiring 10 pieces of the same cov to unbind a piece
